name: RMM Verus-verified spec-bug benchmark (eac5)

detection.obligation: bug present iff Verus REJECTS the assert
detection.contradiction: bug present iff Verus ACCEPTS `ensures false`

note: FP obligation items do not discriminate between generators: a faithful generator fails them exactly as the gold oracle does, because SCOPE's obligation drops a guard the spec actually states. They measure the pipeline's precision ceiling, not generator quality.

items.signature: rd: Address, ipa: Address, result: Result<(), RmiStatusCode>, data: Address, top: Address, old_s: S, new_s: S
requires: rmi_data_destroy_spec(rd, ipa, result, data, top, old_s, new_s)
lets: let old_walk = RttWalk_(old_s, rd, ipa,RMM_RTT_PAGE_LEVEL as int);
let new_walk = RttWalk_(new_s, rd, ipa,RMM_RTT_PAGE_LEVEL as int);
items.label: TP

lets: let old_walk = RttWalk_(old_s, rd, ipa,level - 1 as int);
